feed.title: Yelp reports record $33M in “Other revenue” amid AI push

feed.title: Trust is commerce media’s most valuable currency, says Amex SVP Jake King
feed.summary: Jake King, SVP of Amex Offers Digital Media at American Express, asserts that trust, rather than just data, will define the next phase of commerce media, especially with the rise of AI. He emphasizes that consumers engage with relevant advertising that enhances their experience, and views AI as a trust challenge rather than solely a marketing technology. King believes that companies with established trusted customer relationships will have a competitive advantage over those relying purely on scale and algorithms.

feed.title: SLB and Equinor Sign Multi-Year Stimulation Agreement for Norwegian Continental Shelf
feed.summary: SLB and Equinor have signed a multi-year agreement for advanced reservoir stimulation services on the Norwegian Continental Shelf (NCS). The collaboration aims to maximize recovery from future wells and establish essential infrastructure for future tight-reservoir developments in Norway.
